answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 27784 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to let beard grow longer than a fist? And where does the "fist" start from exactly? Is it from the chin down? Question: Is it permissible to let beard grow longer than a fist? And where does the "fist" start from exactly? Is it from the chin down? Answer ID: 27784 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1955/1462/D=1431) (1) It is lawful but one should not grow it too long that looks odd. (2) Yes, the fist starts from the chin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
